modules.title: Test and debug
goals: Find and fix the bugs in a faulty BFS.
Choose test cases, such as a cycle or a disconnected graph, that expose a bug.

config.prompt: When should BFS mark a neighbor as visited to avoid adding it to the queue twice?

options.label: When it is added to the queue
Only after it is removed from the queue

feedback.dequeue: Marking it on removal lets another vertex enqueue it first.
feedback.finish: The visited set must be updated during traversal, not after it.
